identity.reason: Source and metadata inspection prohibited; commit supplied by requester only.

method.input: JSON-lines helper native CDP touch, at most two contacts; visible coordinates and selectors
method.inspection: Only helper --help read; no game source, tests, docs, prior reviews, recordings, internal handles or target metadata inspected. Each captured screenshot viewed before adaptive input.
method.planning_maps: Opened four times; remained open during inspection and closed with visible #close-map. Final close was followed by terminal loss.
method.pause_limitation: Helper captures live view then automatically taps Pause during play. Inspection and planning were paused, materially easing decision time and interrupting continuous play. No simulation advance or resource modifications.
method.graphics: Synthetic Chromium touch emulation; helper reported Software-WebGL fallback enabled, renderer not certified.

outcome.time_label_note: End screen says CUMULATIVE PLAY TIME; this was one fresh attempt.

experienced: Sustained fire and FIRE drag while simultaneously strafing
Map routing and receiver selection defaults
Mara and Sera recovery using HOLD USE
Damage, shield recovery and low-health feedback

helpful.detail: A sustained centered burst removed the opening guard while health/shield stayed 100/60; terminal screen later confirmed one elimination.
Map route and exact 0.4 m outside-reach prompt supported a small correction and successful USE recovery.
Holding USE while making a small two-contact movement let me enter reach and recover the second memory.
PHASE BREAK / SHOT CANCELED / ARMOR OPEN 3s clearly explained the successful interruption. This did not produce a terminal phase-evade credit.
Rain, cool cyan lighting, oversized relay machinery and restrained title typography establish a coherent industrial atmosphere.

frustrating.detail: A long left swipe overshot my intended west heading to 218 degrees. Shorter corrections and repeated map checks were needed; nonlinear long-swipe behavior was disclosed in handbook.
A full magazine fired during strafing did not confirm a kill. FIRE drag worked, but maintaining target alignment while moving was difficult for me; 16% terminal accuracy supports that limitation.

I mistook nearby scenery for the receiver, moved the wrong direction, held USE out of range, then ran into cover. Distance feedback helped, but the ring/open approach was hard to locate. Health dropped from 100 to 12 during these attempts.
Right-side button grid occupies much of the combat view; small threat text and ground/path markers need close inspection at 844x390. Main health, ammo and handbook text remain legible.

failures_and_uncertainties: No confirmed elimination beyond the opening guard; did not resolve patrol pressure before recovery attempts.
VAULT was tapped after its visible prompt, but subsequent view does not establish whether a useful vault occurred.
Sequence 23 returned Selector must be visible after final map close. Subsequent capture showed actual terminal loss at 01:05; cannot establish which later touch actions in that command executed.
No pageErrors were reported in successful capture results. This is not a source-level or general stability certification.
Loss reflects this reviewer’s first-attempt navigation and combat mistakes as well as observed usability friction; it does not prove the game is unwinnable.

scores.scale: 0 = unusable; 5 = mixed but playable with substantial friction; 8 = strong with minor friction; 10 = exceptional within observed scope. Subjective first-attempt emulated mobile scores, not completion or physical-device certification.

reasons.overall_mobile: Playable and atmospheric; two memories recovered, but turning, moving aim and East Archive approach caused repeated friction and terminal loss.
reasons.controls: Two-contact movement/fire and USE worked; long-swipe overshoot, moving aim and dense button placement hindered precision.
reasons.gameplay: Receiver objectives, patrol pressure and DASH interruption provide understandable tactical choices; later jammer/uplink loop unassessed.
reasons.presentation: Coherent lighting, rain, relay landmarks and polished title/end panels; score excludes audio and physical hardware smoothness.
reasons.usability: Good handbook, paused routing, reach distances and feedback; open approach around East cover remained confusing to this first-time reviewer.
reasons.readability: Large health/ammo and handbook readable; fine map details, threat labels and floor markers are less comfortable at this landscape size.

limits: Hardware performance and thermal/battery behavior unassessed
Continuous enjoyment, pacing and reaction-time demands unassessed because captures pause play
Software-WebGL synthetic Chromium results must not certify physical-device experience
Single loss attempt; jammer, uplink and win experience unassessed

cleanup.result: Exact owned driver and Chrome PIDs absent; no processes killed.
